title: Three Questions to Ask for Machine Learning Model Deployment

cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: In the last video we covered, what is machine learning model deployment and why would you want to deploy a machine learning model?
cues.zh: 上一段影片談了什麼是機器學習模型部署，以及為什麼要部署機器學習模型。

cues.en: And of course, one of the main reasons is to test on the fourth data set to test your model in the real world.
cues.zh: 其中一個主要原因，當然是要在第四個資料集，也就是真實世界中測試模型。

cues.en: I mean, metrics on your training, validation and test sets.
cues.zh: 也就是說，訓練集、驗證集和測試集的指標，

cues.en: Of course, then nice to see those numbers go up on a page, but it's even cooler to see your model perform in the real world.
cues.zh: 看到頁面上的數字提高當然很好，但看到模型在真實世界中發揮作用更酷。

cues.en: And plus, if you deploy your model to the real world, well, then you can start to find out errors that you didn't necessarily find on the training, validation or test set.
cues.zh: 而且，部署到真實世界後，你就能開始找出在訓練集、驗證集或測試集中未必發現的錯誤。

cues.en: Then we looked at our PyTorch workflow and added another step here, which was to deploy and monitor.
cues.zh: 接著我們看了 PyTorch 工作流程，新增了「部署與監控」這一步。

cues.en: We see our model just replicating all over the world there.
cues.zh: 可以看到模型在世界各地不斷出現。

cues.en: Deploy a monitor.
cues.zh: 部署與監控。

cues.en: And then if we find something wrong, we can update it when necessary.
cues.zh: 如果發現問題，就在必要時更新模型。

cues.en: Then we went and reviewed the Machine Learning Engineer steps to download a paper.
cues.zh: 接著我們複習了成為機器學習工程師的步驟，先下載一篇論文。

cues.en: We've already done that or we've implemented the Vision Transformer paper.
cues.zh: 這點已經做過了，我們實作了 Vision Transformer 論文。

cues.en: Keep doing that too.
cues.zh: 持續重複，直到

cues.en: You have skills.
cues.zh: 具備相應的技能。

cues.en: So that's going to take a little bit of practice to keep going.
cues.zh: 所以需要不斷練習，繼續做下去。

cues.en: But then if you want to take it even further, well, the next step would be machine learning engineering.
cues.zh: 如果你想再往前走一步，下一步就是機器學習工程。

cues.en: So if these steps are machine learning research, machine learning engineering would be making your research available to others.
cues.zh: 如果這些步驟算機器學習研究，機器學習工程就是讓其他人能使用你的研究成果。

cues.en: So building infrastructure such as deployment infrastructure and monitoring infrastructure around your models and data preprocessing steps.
cues.zh: 也就是在模型與資料前處理步驟周邊，建立部署與監控等基礎設施。

cues.en: And we defined the workflow we've been going through as more of a general machine learning workflow to find some data and build a model to find patterns in it.
cues.zh: 我們把一路使用的流程，定義為比較一般的機器學習工作流程：找到一些資料，建立模型，找出其中的模式。

cues.en: But the broader workflow of machine learning operations is the extension of this workflow.
cues.zh: 範圍更廣的機器學習維運流程，則是這套流程的延伸。

cues.en: So to deploy and monitor it, which is machine learning operations or ML Ops, also known as Machine learning engineering and for extra resources.
cues.zh: 也就是部署與監控，稱為機器學習維運或 MLOps；講者這裡也稱它為機器學習工程。至於額外資源，

cues.en: On that rapidly evolving topic, I'd highly recommend here this is in PyTorch extra resources.
cues.zh: 這個領域快速演進，我很推薦這裡的內容，放在 PyTorch 額外資源區。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 找到了。

cues.en: So we covered a fair bit of ground in the last video we left on the question what kinds of machine learning model deployments are there?
cues.zh: 上一段影片談了不少內容，最後留下的問題是：機器學習模型部署有哪些類型？

cues.en: And so when I go to deploy machine learning models, I like to ask myself a few questions.
cues.zh: 當我要部署機器學習模型時，喜歡先問自己幾個問題。

cues.en: So I start with the most ideal use case.
cues.zh: 我會從最理想的使用情境開始。

cues.en: So the question what is my most ideal machine learning model deployment scenario?
cues.zh: 第一個問題是：我最理想的機器學習模型部署情境是什麼？

cues.en: I start here and then I work backwards.
cues.zh: 先從這裡出發，再反推需要做的事。

cues.en: Then I ask where's my model going to go?
cues.zh: 接著問：我的模型要放在哪裡？

cues.en: And finally, how is my model going to function?
cues.zh: 最後問：我的模型要如何運作？

cues.en: And now, of course, there are more questions, but these are three of my favorites.
cues.zh: 當然，還有其他問題，但這三個是我最喜歡的。

cues.en: So what is my most ideal machine learning model deployment scenario?
cues.zh: 我最理想的機器學習模型部署情境是什麼？

cues.en: Well, the ideal scenario for me would be that my model works every time, as in for food Vision.
cues.zh: 對我來說，理想情況是模型每次都能正確運作，例如 FoodVision

cues.en: Many.
cues.zh: Mini。

cues.en: Well, that's what we're going to be doing.
cues.zh: 這就是我們接下來要做的。

cues.en: We're going to be working on Food Vision, many becoming machine learning engineers ourselves.
cues.zh: 我們要處理 FoodVision Mini，親自成為機器學習工程師。

cues.en: So our ideal scenario would be that Food Vision many works every time.
cues.zh: 所以，理想情況是 FoodVision Mini 每次都能正確運作。

cues.en: Every time someone takes a photo of food, food, vision, many gets it right.
cues.zh: 每當有人拍攝食物照片，FoodVision Mini 都能辨識正確。

cues.en: Is that possible?
cues.zh: 有可能嗎？

cues.en: Well, this is the most ideal use case, right?
cues.zh: 這可是最理想的使用情境，對吧？

cues.en: And then number two is that it works very fast as in it works at the speed of light.
cues.zh: 第二點是運作非常快，也就是以光速運作。

cues.en: Why the speed of light?
cues.zh: 為什麼是光速？

cues.en: Well, because we're dealing with technology here.
cues.zh: 因為我們處理的是科技。

cues.en: And computers can operate at their very fastest at the speed of light because we're moving data around electronic components, we're not really going to get the actual speed of light.
cues.zh: 電腦最快的運作極限是光速，但資料要在電子元件之間移動，所以實際上達不到光速。

cues.en: There's always going to be a little bit of a delay, but that's the most ideal use case.
cues.zh: 總會有一點延遲，不過那是最理想的情況。

cues.en: So here we go for Food Vision Mini.
cues.zh: 所以，FoodVision Mini 的理想情境是，

cues.en: It works every time and we've got the speed of light.
cues.zh: 每次都正確，而且以光速運作。

cues.en: That's our goal.
cues.zh: 這就是我們的目標。

cues.en: So we have to start here and then work backwards to get towards here.
cues.zh: 先有這個目標，再往回推，逐步朝它前進。

cues.en: Now next, where's my model going to go?
cues.zh: 接著，我的模型要放在哪裡？

cues.en: So in the case of Food Vision Mini, what are our options?
cues.zh: 以 FoodVision Mini 而言，有哪些選項？

cues.en: Or really these are more general, these options here, but we're going to apply this question directly to Food Vision many.
cues.zh: 其實這些選項適用範圍很廣，不過我們會把問題直接套用到 FoodVision Mini。

cues.en: So where's my model going to go on device as in the edge or the cloud.
cues.zh: 模型要放在哪裡？裝置端，也就是邊緣端，還是雲端？

cues.en: So on device would mean that there's a machine learning model on the actual device you're using.
cues.zh: 裝置端的意思，是模型就在你實際使用的裝置上。

cues.en: So in our case for Food Vision, many if we deployed that to a mobile phone, our model would live on that mobile phone.
cues.zh: 以 FoodVision Mini 為例，如果部署到手機，模型就存放在那支手機上。

cues.en: Whereas the cloud.
cues.zh: 至於雲端，

cues.en: What is the cloud?
cues.zh: 什麼是雲端？

cues.en: What is the cloud?
cues.zh: 什麼是雲端？

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 找到了。

cues.en: The cloud is made up of servers in data centers all over the world.
cues.zh: 雲端由世界各地資料中心中的伺服器組成。

cues.en: Moving to the cloud can save companies money and add convenience for users.
cues.zh: 轉移到雲端可以替公司節省成本，也能為使用者帶來便利。

cues.en: Beautiful.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So the cloud refers to servers that are accessed over the Internet and the software databases that run on those servers.
cues.zh: 所以，雲端指的是透過網際網路存取的伺服器，以及在那些伺服器上執行的軟體與資料庫。

cues.en: So when we say or when people say the cloud, if we deploy our model to the cloud, that just means it's on a computer that isn't the actual device that we're using.
cues.zh: 當我們或其他人說把模型部署到雲端，只是表示它位於另一台電腦上，並非我們正在使用的實體裝置。

cues.en: So we'll revisit these two concepts later on.
cues.zh: 稍後會再談這兩個概念。

cues.en: And then finally we asked the question, how is my model going to function?
cues.zh: 最後，我們會問：模型要如何運作？

cues.en: So we've got the most ideal use case.
cues.zh: 我們已經想好了最理想的使用情境，

cues.en: We figure out where it's going to go.
cues.zh: 也決定了模型要放在哪裡，

cues.en: Then we ask, How is my model going to function?
cues.zh: 接著就問：模型要如何運作？

cues.en: And of course, you can jump in between these.
cues.zh: 當然，這幾個問題之間可以來回調整。

cues.en: There's no real order to this.
cues.zh: 沒有一定的先後順序。

cues.en: Number one would be online in real time.
cues.zh: 第一種是線上，即時運作。

cues.en: Number two would be offline.
cues.zh: 第二種是離線，

cues.en: So in a batch way, let me give an example.
cues.zh: 以批次方式處理。我舉個例子。

cues.en: Online would mean real time.
cues.zh: 線上指的是即時處理。

cues.en: We take a photo with food vision many and it returns predictions instantly.
cues.zh: 我們用 FoodVision Mini 拍攝照片，就立刻得到預測結果。

cues.en: Now offline would be, hey, maybe we take ten photos and then we get predictions an hour later.
cues.zh: 離線則可能是拍十張照片，一小時後才拿到預測。

cues.en: So it does it in batch.
cues.zh: 也就是批次處理。

cues.en: So the main two difference here is one is real time, one is later on has a little bit of a delay.
cues.zh: 所以，兩者主要差別是一個即時，另一個稍後才完成，有一點延遲。

cues.en: So we've actually already been doing offline machine learning modelling for our training.
cues.zh: 其實在訓練時，我們已經在做離線機器學習建模。

cues.en: We train on a batch of examples at a time and of course these can mix and match depending on your use case on device models tend to be smaller because there's not much compute on a mobile phone.
cues.zh: 每次用一批樣本訓練。當然，也可以依使用情境混合搭配。裝置端模型通常比較小，因為手機的運算資源有限。

cues.en: So we could have one model on the device and if it doesn't work very well, well then it defaults to going to a cloud model because the cloud offers almost infinite compute.
cues.zh: 我們可以在裝置上放一個模型，如果表現不夠好，就改用雲端模型，因為雲端提供的運算資源幾乎沒有上限。

cues.en: And then same here, we've just discussed that we could have our prediction pipeline is real time.
cues.zh: 這裡也一樣，剛才談到預測流程可以是即時的。

cues.en: So when someone takes a photo of food, it gives the result back straight away, whereas our training pipeline is offline.
cues.zh: 有人拍攝食物照片時，立刻回傳結果；但訓練流程則是離線的。

cues.en: So what happens in a batch format, that's a little bit of a delay.
cues.zh: 也就是以批次方式進行，會有一點延遲。

cues.en: So these are the three questions to ask What is my most ideal machine learning model deployment scenario for food vision many or for general machine learning models is it works every time.
cues.zh: 這就是三個問題。第一個，我最理想的模型部署情境是什麼？對 FoodVision Mini 或一般機器學習模型而言，就是每次都能正確運作。

cues.en: That would be amazing if it did.
cues.zh: 如果真能做到就太棒了。

cues.en: Now, of course, in the world of probabilistic models, that is very unlikely.
cues.zh: 當然，在機率模型的世界裡，這種情況非常不可能。

cues.en: And two, it works at the speed of light because a slow app is a boring app, right?
cues.zh: 第二個理想是以光速運作，因為慢吞吞的 app 很無趣，對吧？

cues.en: We want our predictions to be as fast as possible.
cues.zh: 我們希望預測越快越好。

cues.en: Then once we've got our most ideal use case, it's helpful to think about where's my model going to go?
cues.zh: 想好最理想的使用情境之後，再思考模型要放在哪裡，會很有幫助。

cues.en: Does it live on the actual device or can it live on the cloud?
cues.zh: 它是在實際裝置上，還是可以放在雲端？

cues.en: And we'll discuss this this question a bit more in a second.
cues.zh: 稍後會更深入討論這個問題。

cues.en: And then how is my model going to function?
cues.zh: 接著，模型要如何運作？

cues.en: Is it online?
cues.zh: 是線上的嗎？

cues.en: So does it return predictions in real time?
cues.zh: 也就是即時回傳預測嗎？

cues.en: So as soon as data comes in, predictions come back.
cues.zh: 資料一進來，預測結果就回來。

cues.en: Or does it work in an offline fashion, such as training, a model offline?
cues.zh: 或者採離線方式運作，例如離線訓練模型？

cues.en: Or the predictions take a little while to come back.
cues.zh: 也可能預測結果要過一段時間才回來。

cues.en: So have a think about these and we're going to dive into each of these a little bit more before we get into some code.
cues.zh: 先想想這些問題。在開始寫程式之前，我們會再深入探討。

cues.en: I'll see you in the next video.
cues.zh: 下一段影片見。
